ev.q: In 17 states, the age-adjusted drug-poisoning death rate was significantly higher than the overall U.S. rate of 13.2 deaths per 100,000 population.
The five states with the highest poisoning death rates were West Virginia (36.3)
differences between the U.S. and state estimates were evaluated using two-sided significance tests at the 0.01 level.
